rule_hit_review.why: Ingredient or active name used as the product's own name, as on the pack and page; not a style problem.

tone_read: Calm, ingredient-first ingredient headline in Minimalist's voice with no fear, hype or emoji. The text is short and drawn from page usage or sourcing lines.
